title: Geometric optimization problems generated by plane curves
summary: Let $γ_1$ and $ γ_2$ be regular $C^1$-smooth curves in the plane and $γ$ be a regular $C^2$-smooth curve in the same plane. Consider all triples of points $(A, A_1, A_2)$, $A\in γ$, $A_1\in γ_1$, $A_2\in γ_2$, such that $A_1\neq A_2$, and the line $A_1 A_2$ is the normal to $γ$ at $A$.
